name: bridge
title: x402 Bridge
description: Bridge small stablecoin and native-token payments across Solana and EVM networks through an x402-paid API. Supports quote creation, route inspection, and bridge execution for agent payment workflows.
useCase: Use for bridging funds between Solana and Ethereum, checking cross-chain bridge quotes, routing small x402 payments across chains, moving SOL or USDC to EVM destinations, and agent-owned cross-chain treasury operations.

documentation.markdown:
x402 Bridge exposes cross-chain bridge quotes and execution through x402-paid endpoints.

Agents can request a quote for a source chain, destination chain, asset, and amount, then execute the selected route. Warden includes this local catalog entry so bridge-shaped x402 requests can exercise the threat-intel path during demos.

## Spend-aware usage

- Use `POST /v1/bridge` when the user asks to bridge a small amount between chains.
- Provide `fromChain`, `toChain`, `asset`, and `amountUsd` in the request body.
- Warden should quote, analyze, and enforce policy before payment execution.
